description:
Yavimaya causes all lands to be Forests in addition to their other types, thus Life and Limb causes all lands to be 1/1 Saproling creatures.
Because Ethereal Absolution gives all creatures your opponents control -1/-1, they die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Whenever an opponent plays a land, it will also die as a state-based action.
